question: Who wrote the book " A Brief History of Time"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Stephen Hawking.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Stephen Hawking** was a renowned **theoretical physicist and cosmologist.**
 
• **A Brief History of Time **is one of his **most popular books, **which explains **complex scientific concepts** in a simplified manner for the general audience.
 
• Stephen Hawking's A Brief History of Time has sold over** 10 million copies worldwide** and has been translated into **40 languages**, making it one of the **best-selling science books** ever published.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Albert Einstein** is often regarded as one of the** greatest physicists **of all time
 
• **John Watson** is a **fictional character,** and **Neil Degrasse Tyson** is a **contemporary astrophysicist.**
